scope: Stage 3A metadata and receipt-validation foundation only. No application was launched; no baseline frame or ordinary check was captured or replayed.

plan_binding.required_creation_digest: Externally supplied SHA-256 from fresh-plan publication; plan bytes are revalidated through the no-follow stable reader and current source/tool/inventory verification.
manifest_bindings: cohort ID and four binary digests

custody.key: 32 random bytes created with O_EXCL and O_NOFOLLOW, mode 0600, single-link regular file outside Git, source, binaries, and capture artifacts.
custody.disclosure: Key bytes are absent from manifest, logs, environment, and receipt output. Verification checks stable file identity and permissions.
custody.publication: Run directory is claimed with exclusive mkdir; manifest is published atomically without replacement and directory-fsynced. Existing run roots and keys are preserved and rejected.

receipt_validation.implemented: Pure HMAC receipt-chain validator checks exact planned order, no duplicate or skipped cases, predecessor digests, current run/plan/cohort/source/binary/runtime bindings, and nonzero visual checkpoints or ordinary assertions.
receipt_validation.trust_boundary: No CLI command accepts or signs arbitrary outcomes. No journal writer, phase advance, capture, replay, or finalization command is exposed in this increment.
receipt_validation.partial_prefix: A valid authenticated prefix reports incomplete and cannot imply full inventory completion or acceptance. Failed, skipped, zero-checkpoint, stale, malformed, or reordered receipts are rejected.

remaining_gates: Independent exact-commit review is required before any phase advancement implementation.

Future advancement must use the pinned tuiscotti harness and verify signed per-process launch and close receipts, nonzero ordered checkpoints, expected artifact immutability, and pre/post source/binary/environment identities.
The fresh capture cohort grants no candidate comparison or checkpoint reference approval; existing reference conflicts remain unresolved and red.
